#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Comprehensive test for the usage report feature to be potentially added to the test suite.
"""

from unittest import TestCase
from unittest.mock import Mock
from lando.k8s.jobmanager import JobManager, RunWorkflowConfig


class TestUsageReportFeature(TestCase):
    
    def setUp(self):
        self.mock_job = Mock(
            username='testuser',
            workflow=Mock(url='test_workflow.cwl', job_order={'test': 'data'}),
            volume_size=5,
            job_flavor_cpus=4,
            job_flavor_memory='8G',
        )
        self.mock_job.id = '123'
        self.mock_job.vm_settings = None
        self.mock_job.k8s_settings = Mock()
        
    def test_run_workflow_config_without_record_usage_defaults_to_false(self):
        """Test that RunWorkflowConfig defaults record_usage to False when not set."""
        self.mock_job.k8s_settings.run_workflow = Mock(
            image_name='test_image',
            cpus=2,
            memory='4Gi',
            base_command=["cwltool"],
            # No record_usage attribute
        )
        
        config = RunWorkflowConfig(self.mock_job, Mock())
        self.assertFalse(config.record_usage)
    
    def test_run_workflow_config_with_record_usage_true(self):
        """Test that RunWorkflowConfig correctly reads record_usage=True."""
        self.mock_job.k8s_settings.run_workflow = Mock(
            image_name='test_image',
            cpus=2,
            memory='4Gi',
            base_command=["cwltool"],
            record_usage=True,
        )
        
        config = RunWorkflowConfig(self.mock_job, Mock())
        self.assertTrue(config.record_usage)
    
    def test_run_workflow_config_with_record_usage_false(self):
        """Test that RunWorkflowConfig correctly reads record_usage=False."""
        self.mock_job.k8s_settings.run_workflow = Mock(
            image_name='test_image',
            cpus=2,
            memory='4Gi',
            base_command=["cwltool"],
            record_usage=False,
        )
        
        config = RunWorkflowConfig(self.mock_job, Mock())
        self.assertFalse(config.record_usage)
        
    def test_create_run_workflow_job_without_usage_report(self):
        """Test that command is generated without usage report when record_usage is False or not set."""
        self.mock_job.k8s_settings.run_workflow = Mock(
            image_name='test_image',
            cpus=2,
            memory='4Gi',
            base_command=["cwltool"],
            record_usage=False,  # Explicitly disable
        )
        self.mock_job.k8s_settings.organize_output = Mock(
            image_name='organize_image',
            cpus=1,
            memory='2Gi',
            base_command=["python", "-m", "lando_util.organize_project"],
        )
        self.mock_job.k8s_settings.save_output = Mock(
            image_name='save_image',
            cpus=1,
            memory='2Gi',
            base_command=["python", "-m", "lando_util.upload"],
        )
        self.mock_job.k8s_settings.record_output_project = Mock(
            image_name='record_image',
            cpus=1,
            memory='1Gi'
        )
        
        mock_cluster_api = Mock()
        mock_config = Mock(storage_class_name='nfs')
        manager = JobManager(cluster_api=mock_cluster_api, config=mock_config, job=self.mock_job)
        
        manager.create_run_workflow_job()
        
        # Get the command that was created
        args, kwargs = mock_cluster_api.create_job.call_args
        name, batch_spec = args
        job_container = batch_spec.container
        command = job_container.command
        
        # Verify command doesn't contain usage report flag
        command_str = ' '.join(command)
        self.assertNotIn('--usage-report', command_str)
        
    def test_create_run_workflow_job_with_usage_report(self):
        """Test that command includes usage report flag when record_usage is True."""
        self.mock_job.k8s_settings.run_workflow = Mock(
            image_name='test_image',
            cpus=2,
            memory='4Gi',
            base_command=["cwltool"],
            record_usage=True,  # Enable usage reporting
        )
        self.mock_job.k8s_settings.organize_output = Mock(
            image_name='organize_image',
            cpus=1,
            memory='2Gi',
            base_command=["python", "-m", "lando_util.organize_project"],
        )
        self.mock_job.k8s_settings.save_output = Mock(
            image_name='save_image',
            cpus=1,
            memory='2Gi',
            base_command=["python", "-m", "lando_util.upload"],
        )
        self.mock_job.k8s_settings.record_output_project = Mock(
            image_name='record_image',
            cpus=1,
            memory='1Gi'
        )
        
        mock_cluster_api = Mock()
        mock_config = Mock(storage_class_name='nfs')
        manager = JobManager(cluster_api=mock_cluster_api, config=mock_config, job=self.mock_job)
        
        manager.create_run_workflow_job()
        
        # Get the command that was created
        args, kwargs = mock_cluster_api.create_job.call_args
        name, batch_spec = args
        job_container = batch_spec.container
        command = job_container.command
        
        # Verify command contains usage report flag with correct path
        command_str = ' '.join(command)
        self.assertIn('--usage-report', command_str)
        self.assertIn('/bespin/output-data/results/usage-report.json', command_str)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import unittest
    unittest.main()
